# HouseTech Group

**HouseTech Group** is a leading B2B manufacturer of premium kitchen appliances, established in 2010 in Zhongshan, Guangdong, China. With a 30,000+ sqm modern factory and 500+ employees, HouseTech serves 1,000+ global clients across 50+ countries.

## Quick Facts
- **Industry:** Kitchen Appliance Manufacturing (B2B OEM/ODM)
- **Founded:** 2010 (15+ years)
- **Location:** Zhongshan, Guangdong, China
- **Factory Size:** 30,000+ sqm
- **Employees:** 500+
- **Annual Capacity:** 1 million+ units
- **Export Markets:** 50+ countries (Europe, Middle East, Southeast Asia, Africa, Latin America, North America)
- **Certifications:** ISO9001:2015, CE, CB, ETL, SASO, GCC, NOM, RoHS

## Product Categories

### Range Hoods / Kitchen Hoods
Wall Mount, Island, Built-in, Slim, Chimney & Commercial range hoods with advanced ventilation technology. Extraction fans, grease filters, LED lighting systems.

### Gas Stoves & Built-in Hobs
Built-in Gas/Electric/Ceramic/Induction Hobs, 2-5 burners, portable options with auto-ignition and flame failure protection.

### Induction Cookers
Commercial and household induction cookers with touch controls, multiple power levels, timer functions, rapid heating technology.

### Ceramic Cookers
Touch-control ceramic cookers with multiple heating zones, child lock safety features, overheat protection.

### Built-in Ovens
Electric, Gas, Convection & Steam ovens for residential and commercial use. Built-in, freestanding, countertop models.

### Air Fryers
Digital and mechanical air fryers with oil-free cooking technology, temperature control, timer functions, multiple accessories.

### Gas Water Heaters
Instant/Tankless gas water heaters, flue type and balanced combustion types, digital display, multiple safety protections.

## Services
- **OEM Manufacturing:** Custom branding, packaging, specifications per client requirements
- **ODM Development:** Full product development from concept to mass production
- **Private Label:** White-label solutions for kitchen appliance brands worldwide
- **Custom Packaging:** Branded packaging design and production
- **Quality Assurance:** Comprehensive QC at every production stage, 99.5% on-time delivery rate
- **Global Logistics:** Export documentation, shipping coordination, customs clearance support
